# The Same Old Rhythm — or Not?

<!-- STEP id="two-cars" -->
Watch two cars on straight roads. One holds a steady speed. The other speeds up steadily.

<!-- STEP id="markers-every-second" -->
A camera drops a marker on each lane every second.

The steady car's markers stay evenly spaced. The speeding car's markers spread further and further apart.

<!-- STEP id="uniform-vs-nonuniform" -->
**Uniform motion** means equal distances in equal time intervals — a constant speed.

**Non-uniform motion** means unequal distances in equal time intervals — the speed is changing.

**Equal distances in equal times = uniform. Unequal distances in equal times = non-uniform.**
